major_findings.summary: False brown-butter dependency into the pear branch
major_findings.evidence: The original caramelize-pears operation takes only pears, while the candidate also consumes out-brown-butter, turning an independent pear branch into a branch downstream of brown-butter and changing material routing.

rationale: All recipe content is otherwise faithfully reconstructed, but the added brown-butter input is a material false branch and prevents equivalence under the topology criterion.
